newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil 9-mo pre-tax rises 33 pct - MC.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil 9-mo pre-tax rises 33 pct - MC.

text.p: Russian oil company NK LUKoil's 0#LKOH.RUO nine-month pre-tax profit rose 33 percent to $625 million, MC Securities said.
A LUKoil spokesman said figures had not been officially released.

"I cannot confirm we have issued this report officially. There was some kind of technical disruption of the process when, at the request of several major investment banks this report was by mistake distributed before the official distribution started," said LUKoil head of investor relations Pyotr Neyev.
